title: NSF Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
eligibility: U.S. citizens, nationals, or permanent residents who are seniors, bachelor's holders with no grad enrollment, or first-year grad students entering research-based STEM programs
benefit: $37,000/year stipend plus $16,000/year cost-of-education allowance, 3 years of support over 5
description: FY2027 deadlines vary by field (8 pm ET): Oct 19, 2026 Life Sciences; Oct 20 CISE, Materials, Psychology, Social Sciences; Oct 22 Engineering; Oct 23 Chemistry, Geosciences, Math, Physics & Astronomy. Reference letters due Oct 16, 2026.

title: Hertz Fellowship
eligibility: Promising doctoral students in applied sciences, engineering, and mathematics (see Who Can Apply)
benefit: Up to five years of funding valued at up to $250,000
description: The 2027 Fellowship application is open through October 30, 2026.

title: NDSEG Fellowship
eligibility: U.S. citizens or nationals pursuing doctorates in DoD-relevant science and engineering fields (check eligibility page)
description: The FY2027 application period runs August 3 through October 30, 2026 (5 pm Eastern).
